cohorts.train_visual: 12 unique TRAIN, translation then rotation per letter; minhash among frozenfirst480-exposed fullH4legal windows, prior role excluded
cohorts.val_motion: at most1 H1obvious-motion H4legal anchor pervaltrajectory after natural exclusion; missing support retained
cohorts.val_natural: 1 minhash H4legal anchor per frozenvaltrajectory, no motion filter; trajectories deliberately contain motion, so not unbiased natural test

display: truth preview only from saveduint8RGB; white/gray/blue unaltered, action charts/text outside image panels; no predictions created

model_callback.feedback: original generated rawRGB only; finite out-of-range unchanged; no future truth/state/pose/template/environment render/repair
model_callback.hard_stop: nonfinite/wrongshape/callback failure stopscohort, preserves rawfailure and every frozen denominator; no retries
model_callback.normalization: absolute.astype(float32)/511*2-1 exactly once; callback goes directly to normalized native sampler, NEVER old absolute-action wrapper or inverse/renormalize
model_callback.pairing: same cohort/order/batchshape and domain-separated perbatch+step seed for original/final; no claim of independent perwindow diffusion noise

obvious_motion: H1 area-centroid displacement>=2 image96px OR abs raw unwrapped rotation>=5deg; small_or_static is only a historical variable name for the complement, display near-static/small motion, never exact static; no old2worldpx main criterion
scope: preparation only; zero current model/inference/training authorization

score.acceptance: no new pass target declared here; paired errors/wins/hardfail/unknown per cohort and horizon, TRAIN fit is not unseen-shape transfer
score.hard_failures: status/missing/wrongshape/nonfinite/out-of-range/emptygray/emptyblue retain denominator and existing penalties; rawvalues saved unmodified
score.object: unaligned visible-gray 1-IoU,gray fixedLAST|TRUE ROI RGBMAE,raw contour distance; blue pusher metrics separate
score.shape: occlusion/border/unassessable remains unknown; failFalse alone is never a shape/rigidity guarantee
score.small_or_static: report gray prediction-vs-LAST drift separately for H1non-obvious windows, with actual truth amplitudes; not a requirement to beat zero-error copylast

timeline.h4_audit_action_prefix: a-3..a+3,7 actual actions for audit, NEVER all7 in one GPC call
timeline.validity: all7 history/future transitions valid; no cross-trajectory windows
